messages.高威力の1コインで火傷と振動を押し付け、振動爆発による混乱を起点に火傷を他の敵へ: A Wrath Blunt E.G.O that forces Burn and Tremor onto the target with a high-power single Coin, then spreads Burn to other enemies starting from a Tremor Burst Stagger.
messages.火傷の付与: 的中時に対象へ火傷4(解析Ⅲで7、Ⅳで10)を付与する。さらに解析: **Inflicting Burn**: On hit, inflicts 4 Burn on the target (7 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10 at Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also inflicts Burn on 5 random enemies.
messages.振動と振動爆発: 対象の火傷の数値と同じだけ振動を付与し、そのまま振動爆発させる: **Tremor and Tremor Burst**: Inflicts Tremor equal to the target's Burn value and triggers Tremor Burst right away (the burst reduces Tremor Count, from 3 to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.混乱で火傷を拡散: 振動爆発で対象が混乱すると、ランダムな敵5名の火傷回数が増え: **Spreading Burn through Stagger**: If the Tremor Burst staggers the target, 5 random enemies gain Burn Count (1, 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 3 at Ⅳ).
messages.次ターンの強化: 攻撃後、次のターンにクイック、憤怒威力増加1、打撃威力増加1を: **Next-turn buffs**: After the attack, he gains Haste, 1 Wrath Power Up, and 1 Blunt Power Up next turn.
messages.パッシブ「冷ませぬ興奮」: 戦闘開始時に2つ以上のスキルの標的なら基本威力+1。: **Passive — Untempered Agitation**: +1 Base Power if he is targeted by 2 or more skills at Combat Start. When taking damage, inflicts 1 Burn on the attacker, up to 5 times per turn.
messages.火傷と振動は威力に偏って回数が少ない。回数は他の人格で補う火傷編成で使う。: Its Burn and Tremor lean toward Potency with little Count. Use it in Burn teams where other Identities cover the Count.
messages.必要資源が5つと軽く、威力も高いのでマッチにも使える。バフは憤怒・打撃スキルに効: It requires only 5 resources and has high power, so it also works for Clashing. Its buffs apply to Wrath and Blunt skills, so leave the next turn to Identities with those skills.
messages.侵蝕スキルは解析Ⅳで広域(加重値3)になる。敵味方識別不可で、火傷の拡散先もラン: The Corrosion skill becomes multi-target (3 Attack Weight) at Threadspin Ⅳ. It cannot distinguish friend from foe, and the Burn spread also goes to random characters, so it can hit allies.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が20に上がり、火傷7、5名への火傷拡散、クイック2が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises to 20, and 7 Burn, Burn spread to 5 enemies, and 2 Haste are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+25になり(最大威力45)、火傷10・拡散3など付与量が増え: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +25 (max power 45), and amounts such as 10 Burn and a spread of 3 increase. Corrosion becomes multi-target.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 怠惰(S1)・色欲(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Sloth (S1), Lust (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and he inflicts both Burn and Tremor.
messages.南部リウ協会6課: 色欲(S1)・怠惰(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色を出: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 6](persona:0502)**: Lust (S1), Sloth (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and S1–S3 inflict Burn to cover the lack of Count.
